clue.text: Make a disc to be the world's best seller

definitions.meaning: to cut a new gramophone recording
to set an all-time high in sales, beating every rival

explanation.surface: A singer cuts a single hoping it will top the charts everywhere.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both cutting a recording and setting an unbeaten mark, here for sales.

clue.text: A sharp blow on the left side evokes sympathy

parts.note: a rap is a sharp knock or blow
port is the left side of a ship

explanation.surface: A slap on someone's left side somehow wins their sympathy.
explanation.walkthrough: PORT is the nautical word for the left-hand side of a vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: Rapport is a close, understanding relationship, a mutual fellow feeling.

clue.text: At work above everything else

parts.note: taken as written
OP is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: Someone at their job ranks above everything else in importance.
explanation.definitionFit: Something placed on top of everything sits higher than all the rest.

clue.text: The fourteenth letter to loved one will 15

parts.note: N, the fourteenth letter of the alphabet, spelt out as a word
amour is French for a love or lover

explanation.surface: A love letter sent to a sweetheart is meant to win them over.
explanation.walkthrough: 15 is CHARM (15-down); the letter N is written as its name, EN.
explanation.definitionFit: To enamour is to captivate or fill with love, much like casting a spell over someone.

clue.text: Income tax returns

parts.note: not the forms filed each year, but money the taxman hands back

explanation.definitionFit: Rebates are partial refunds, so overpaid tax coming back to the payer.

clue.text: Piece of evidence used in a crossword

definitions.meaning: a fact or object that helps a detective
each numbered hint a solver works from

explanation.surface: A detective finds a fact that turns up in a puzzle.
explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both a lead in an investigation and a puzzle's numbered prompt.

clue.text: Somewhat cross initially with the composer

indicators.note: only some of the letters of these words are used, a run found inside them

explanation.surface: A slightly annoyed composer at first.
explanation.definitionFit: Gioachino Rossini was the Italian composer of The Barber of Seville.

clue.text: New moat, perfectly round and airy

indicators.note: something new is made afresh, so these letters are put into a fresh order

parts.note: a sphere is perfectly round, so spherical

explanation.surface: A freshly dug circular moat around an airy castle.
explanation.definitionFit: Atmospherical means relating to the air, hence airy.

clue.text: Showing growing talent in the nursery despite an inexperienced touch

definitions.text: Showing growing talent in the nursery despite an inexperienced touch

parts.words: Showing growing talent in the nursery despite an inexperienced touch
parts.note: the nursery is a plant nursery, and an inexperienced touch suggests a novice's hands that still make things flourish

explanation.definitionFit: Someone with a gift for gardening is said to have a natural knack for making plants thrive.

clue.text: Coati Pa disturbed obtaining starchy substance from a plant

indicators.note: being disturbed means thrown into disorder, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: A coati and its father are disturbed while getting starch from a plant.
explanation.walkthrough: A coati is a South American raccoon relative.
explanation.definitionFit: Tapioca is starch extracted from the root of the cassava plant.

clue.text: Prize-fighter, one who inflicts injuries

explanation.surface: A boxer is someone who hurts people.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a hefty boxer and literally one who causes bruises.

clue.text: Empty order for a musical instrument

indicators.note: read as placed within, so the empty letter goes into the order

parts.note: OBE, Order of the British Empire
empty means nothing, the letter O

explanation.surface: A request with nothing in it for an instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: O (nothing) goes inside OBE, the British honour; the clue gives no stronger container signal than 'for'.
explanation.definitionFit: The oboe is a double-reed woodwind instrument.

clue.text: Heard number being played loudly

indicators.note: heard says the word is to be taken as spoken, by its sound

parts.note: forty is a number

explanation.surface: A number heard performed at full volume.
explanation.definitionFit: Forte is the musical direction for loud.

clue.text: Zero energy of long distance runner

parts.note: nil means nothing, zero
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A marathon runner who has run out of energy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Runner' is a river: the Nile is one of the world's longest.
explanation.definitionFit: A river runs, and the Nile flows thousands of miles through Africa.

clue.text: Bewitch church member

parts.note: an arm is a limb, a member of the body

explanation.surface: A churchgoer casts a spell.
explanation.definitionFit: To bewitch is to put under a spell, enchant.

clue.text: Race in which one does not do all therunning

definitions.text: Race in which one does not do all therunning

parts.words: Race in which one does not do all therunning
parts.note: a team race where each runner covers only a leg

explanation.definitionFit: In a team race runners take turns, each passing a baton to the next.

clue.text: Vessel without stabilisers

parts.note: a ship with no stabilisers would toss up and down at sea; a vessel is also a jug

explanation.definitionFit: A pitcher is a jug, and a ship lacking stabilisers would pitch in heavy seas.

clue.text: He has the star part in a western

definitions.text: He has the star part in a western

parts.words: He has the star part in a western
parts.note: not the lead actor but the lawman who wears a star-shaped badge

explanation.definitionFit: A Wild West lawman wears a tin star badge.

clue.text: Monarch had more trouble through his heart

indicators.note: the second piece is placed at the centre of the first
to trouble something is to stir it up, so these letters are disturbed

parts.note: per means through or by

explanation.surface: A king was in deeper trouble because of his heart condition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trouble' rearranges MORE into EMOR, and 'his heart' sets PER at its centre.
explanation.definitionFit: An emperor is a supreme ruler, a sovereign over an empire.

clue.text: Last letter from Cornish resort for atonement

indicators.note: taken from means removed from the word

parts.note: Penzance is a seaside town in Cornwall, south-west England
Z is the last letter of the alphabet

explanation.surface: A last letter sent from a Cornish holiday town seeking forgiveness.
explanation.definitionFit: Penance is an act of self-punishment done to make amends for wrongdoing.

clue.text: In the game this might be scored by canon hesitantly

definitions.text: In the game this might be scored

parts.note: a canon in music is a round, like Frère Jacques
er is the sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: A churchman scores a run in a game, haltingly.
explanation.walkthrough: Rounders is a British bat-and-ball game like baseball; a run in it is scored as a rounder. 'canon' looks like a clergyman.
explanation.definitionFit: In rounders a player who runs round all the bases scores one point.

clue.text: Late Greek god, expressionless

parts.note: late means deceased
Pan is the Greek god of shepherds

explanation.surface: A dead Greek god shows no emotion.
explanation.definitionFit: A deadpan face is blank, showing no feeling.

clue.text: I am not sure if I am one

definitions.text: I am not sure if I am one

parts.words: I am not sure if I am one
parts.note: anyone uncertain whether they are a sceptic proves they are one

explanation.definitionFit: A sceptic is someone uncertain, so being unsure of it makes the case.

clue.text: Guide dog?

definitions.meaning: a gun dog breed that indicates game

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both an indicator and a gundog that stands to show game.

clue.text: Hotels in opposite directions

parts.note: taken as written
N and S, north and south, are compass opposites

explanation.surface: Hotels spread out in opposite directions.
explanation.definitionFit: Inns are pubs or small hotels offering lodging.

clue.text: Criticise severely and be deeply afflicted

explanation.surface: Harsh criticism leaves someone deeply hurt.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both slashing at someone verbally and being distressed.

clue.text: Bird might be found at the end ofthe line

definitions.text: might be found at the end ofthe line
definitions.meaning: a toy flown on a string

explanation.surface: A bird perched where a railway track ends.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a hawk-like bird and a paper toy flown on a long string.

clue.text: Former sex-appeal is way out

parts.note: ex means former
IT is old slang for sex appeal

explanation.surface: Old-fashioned sex appeal is now outdated.
explanation.definitionFit: An exit is a door or passage leading out.

clue.text: Thought to be material

definitions.meaning: past tense of feel, sensed or believed
a fabric made of matted wool

explanation.surface: Something believed to be cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both the past of feel (sensed) and a matted woollen fabric.

clue.text: Attached to girl by River Dee

parts.note: Ann is a girl's name
the Exe is a river in Devon
dee is the name of the letter D

explanation.surface: A girl is attached to the River Dee.
explanation.walkthrough: 'River Dee' looks like one river; it splits into EXE and D, with Dee read as the letter's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Annexed means joined on or appended to something larger.

clue.text: It holds matinees possibly at three

indicators.note: possibly signals another possible arrangement of these letters

explanation.surface: A venue putting on afternoon shows at three.
explanation.definitionFit: A playhouse stages afternoon performances.

clue.text: They correspond

parts.note: not things that match, but people who exchange mail

explanation.definitionFit: To correspond is to keep up an exchange of letters.
